title: 😴 Arav flips his pillow and counts backward from ten, still wide awake… #shorts #bedtimestories
title_alts: 😴 Why won't Arav's eyes stay shut, however hard he counts in the dark? #shorts #bedtimestories
😴 Arav and the crib that squeaks in a dark bedroom nobody can sleep in… #shorts #bedtimestories
refrain: Hush now, hum now, sleep comes near
description_hook: Arav has counted every star on his ceiling and sleep still will not come. Then the crib squeaks, and he finds out that settling someone else is what settles him.

characters.name: Arav
characters.description: five years old, short black hair, blue star-print pyjamas, sleeps with one arm hanging off the mattress

scenes.narration: Arav lies awake in the dark bedroom. He only wants sleep. Hush now, hum now, sleep comes near.
scenes.caption: अंधेरे कमरे में आरव जागा है। उसे बस नींद चाहिए। चुप हो, गुनगुना, नींद पास आ रही।
scenes.image_brief: Arav, a five-year-old boy with short black hair in blue star-print pyjamas, lying awake on a low mattress in a shared bedroom at night, eyes wide open, a wooden crib beside him, faint glow from stick-on ceiling stars.

scenes.narration: He squeezes his eyes shut. He flips the pillow over. Still wide awake.
scenes.caption: वह आँखें कसकर बंद करता है। तकिया पलटता है। फिर भी नींद नहीं आती।
scenes.image_brief: Arav on his low mattress with his eyes squeezed shut, both hands lifting and flipping his pillow over, blanket kicked sideways, the shared bedroom lit by one small night lamp.

scenes.narration: Arav counts backward from ten. Nine, eight, seven. Count with me, out loud.
scenes.caption: आरव दस से उलटा गिनता है। नौ, आठ, सात। ज़ोर से मेरे साथ गिनो।
scenes.image_brief: Arav lying on his back on the mattress, counting on his raised fingers with three fingers folded down, looking up at the shared bedroom ceiling, dim night lamp light.

scenes.narration: His legs itch. His chest buzzes like a bee. Then the crib squeaks.
scenes.caption: उसकी टाँगें खुजलाती हैं। सीना मधुमक्खी जैसा भनभनाता है। तभी पालना चरमराता है।
scenes.image_brief: Arav sitting up restless with the blanket twisted round his legs, one hand pressed on his chest, head turned toward the wooden crib nearby where the baby's blanket is moving, dim night lamp light.

scenes.narration: Arav sits up. His baby sister is fussing. He pats her back and hums. Hush now, hum now, sleep comes near.
scenes.caption: आरव उठ बैठता है। नन्ही बहन बेचैन है। चुप हो, गुनगुना, नींद पास आ रही।
scenes.image_brief: Arav sitting up on his mattress and reaching one arm through the wooden crib bars to pat his baby sister's back, his lips rounded as he hums, soft night lamp light across the shared bedroom.

scenes.narration: Hum with me like Arav does. Mmm, mmm, mmm. She sleeps, and Arav smiles.
scenes.caption: आरव जैसे मेरे साथ गुनगुनाओ। म्म, म्म, म्म। बहन सो जाती है, आरव मुस्कुराता है।
scenes.image_brief: Arav kneeling beside the wooden crib with his hand resting on his baby sister's back, the baby lying calm with her eyes closed, warm low light in the shared bedroom.

scenes.narration: Arav's eyes go heavy. He feels quiet inside. Hush now, hum now, sleep comes near.
scenes.caption: आरव की आँखें भारी हो जाती हैं। मन शांत लगता है। चुप हो, गुनगुना, नींद पास आ रही।
scenes.image_brief: Arav slumped sleepily against the side of the wooden crib with his arm still through the bars and his eyelids drooping, his baby sister asleep in the crib, very dim night light in the shared bedroom.

title: 💛 Tara hops for the blue ribbon and the whole field thumps past her… #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
title_alts: 💛 Why is Tara still hopping when everyone else has thumped past her? #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
💛 Tara, one blue ribbon and a sack race that is slipping away from her… #shorts #kidsstories
refrain: Hop, hop, hop, side by side
description_hook: Tara only wanted the blue ribbon in the school sack race. Halfway down the field, she works out what she actually came for.

characters.name: Tara
characters.description: 8 years old, short black ponytail, red school t-shirt and navy shorts, one grass-stained knee

scenes.narration: Tara tugged her sack up on the school field. One thing mattered. The blue ribbon.
scenes.caption: तारा ने स्कूल के मैदान में बोरी खींची। उसे बस नीला रिबन चाहिए था।
scenes.image_brief: Tara, an eight-year-old girl with a short black ponytail, red school t-shirt and navy shorts, standing on a grassy school field in bright morning sunlight, holding a brown jute sack up around her waist, a blue ribbon pinned to a wooden table beside her

scenes.narration: She practised alone. Twelve hops, then a tumble. Kids chanted, Hop, hop, hop, side by side.
scenes.caption: उसने अकेले अभ्यास किया। बारह छलांग, फिर गिर पड़ी। बच्चे बोले: कूदो, कूदो, साथ-साथ!
scenes.image_brief: Tara falling sideways out of her brown jute sack onto the grass of the school field at midday, knees in the grass, three other children sitting on a low stone wall behind her clapping their hands

scenes.narration: Race day. Tara shoved off and slipped sideways. Count her hops with me. One, two, flop!
scenes.caption: दौड़ का दिन। तारा उछली और फिसल गई। मेरे साथ गिनो — एक, दो, धड़ाम!
scenes.image_brief: Tara tipping sideways out of her sack at the chalk starting line of a sack race on the school field, four other children in sacks hopping past her, bright afternoon light on the grass

scenes.narration: Tara's legs burned. Her throat went tight. The others thumped past her, laughing.
scenes.caption: तारा के पैर जलने लगे। गला भर आया। बाकी बच्चे हँसते हुए आगे निकल गए।
scenes.image_brief: Tara sitting up inside her sack halfway down the school field, red-faced and breathing hard, other children in sacks thumping past her and laughing, sun high overhead

scenes.narration: Tara stopped racing and listened. That laughing was what she wanted. Hop, hop, hop, side by side.
scenes.caption: तारा रुकी और सुनने लगी। उसे वही हँसी चाहिए थी। कूदो, कूदो, साथ-साथ!
scenes.image_brief: Tara standing still inside her sack on the school field with her head turned to listen, watching a line of laughing children hop past in their sacks, warm afternoon light

scenes.narration: Tara hopped back and matched a slower kid's bounce. Hop with us, out loud! Both of them laughed.
scenes.caption: तारा लौटकर धीमे बच्चे के साथ कूदी। हमारे साथ ज़ोर से बोलो! दोनों हँस पड़ीं।
scenes.image_brief: Tara hopping in her sack beside a smaller child in a sack near the finish line on the school field, both mid-bounce and laughing, long late-afternoon shadows across the grass

scenes.narration: Tara hugged her sack, grinning, ribbon-less. Hop, hop, hop, side by side.
scenes.caption: तारा बोरी गले लगाकर मुस्कुराई, बिना रिबन। कूदो, कूदो, साथ-साथ!
scenes.image_brief: Tara sitting on the grass at the edge of the school field, hugging her folded brown jute sack and grinning, empty hands with no ribbon, golden evening light

title: 🥺 Vivaan sets out a bowl for the puppy he wants, and a sparrow lands… #shorts #kidsstories
title_alts: 🥺 What does Vivaan do when a sparrow comes instead of a puppy? #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
🥺 Vivaan, an empty balcony and a sparrow that will not be caught… #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
refrain: Quiet hands, and the sparrow stays
description_hook: Vivaan wants a puppy more than anything in the world. Then a sparrow starts building in his tulsi pot, and he finds out what he was really wishing for.

characters.name: Vivaan
characters.description: seven-year-old boy, short black hair with a cowlick at the front, green kurta and grey shorts, always barefoot on the balcony tiles

scenes.narration: Vivaan pressed his nose to the balcony railing. He wanted a puppy. Only a puppy.
scenes.caption: विवान बालकनी की रेलिंग से नाक सटाकर खड़ा था। उसे एक पिल्ला चाहिए था। बस पिल्ला।
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan, a seven-year-old boy in a green kurta, stands barefoot on a small balcony full of potted plants, pressing his nose between the railing bars and watching a woman walk a puppy on the street below, warm late-afternoon sunlight across the tiles.

scenes.narration: He set out a water bowl. No puppy came. A sparrow did. Quiet hands, and the sparrow stays.
scenes.caption: उसने पानी का कटोरा बाहर रखा। पिल्ला नहीं आया। गौरैया आ गई। हाथ शांत रखो, गौरैया रुकेगी।
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan crouches very still on the balcony floor beside a shallow steel bowl of water he has just placed down, while a small brown sparrow perches on the railing above the bowl, low golden evening light between the plant pots.

scenes.narration: Vivaan lunged to catch her. She flew off. Whisper with me: come back, sparrow.
scenes.caption: विवान उसे पकड़ने झपटा। वह उड़ गई। मेरे साथ धीरे कहो: लौट आ, गौरैया।
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan stretches forward across the balcony with both hands cupped and open, reaching for the railing, as the brown sparrow lifts away over the edge with wings spread, the water bowl tipped on its side, orange sky behind the building.

scenes.narration: The balcony felt empty. Vivaan's throat went tight. Quiet hands, and the sparrow stays.
scenes.caption: बालकनी सूनी लगने लगी। विवान का गला भर आया। हाथ शांत रखो, गौरैया रुकेगी।
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan sits alone on the bare balcony floor with his knees pulled up and his hands limp in his lap, chin down and eyes wet, the empty railing and the untouched water bowl beside him, dim blue-grey dusk light.

scenes.narration: Then Vivaan noticed twigs inside his tulsi pot. Not a pet. A neighbour.
scenes.caption: तभी विवान ने तुलसी के गमले में तिनके देखे। पालतू नहीं। पड़ोसी।
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan leans close over a clay tulsi pot on the balcony ledge, eyes wide, looking at a loose ring of twigs and dry grass tucked among the leaves, while the sparrow lands on the pot rim carrying one more twig in her beak, soft dusk light.

scenes.narration: Two speckled eggs. Vivaan refilled the bowl each morning. Looking after her felt better than owning her.
scenes.caption: दो चित्तीदार अंडे। विवान रोज़ सुबह कटोरा भरता। रखने से देखभाल करना ज़्यादा अच्छा लगा।
scenes.image_brief: A small nest in the clay tulsi pot holds two tiny speckled eggs, and Vivaan kneels nearby pouring water into the steel bowl from a jug, smiling with his shoulders relaxed, the sparrow watching from the railing, bright early morning light.

scenes.narration: Say it softly with me, one last time. Quiet hands, and the sparrow stays.
scenes.caption: एक बार फिर मेरे साथ धीरे से कहो। हाथ शांत रखो, गौरैया रुकेगी।
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan sits cross-legged and completely still on the balcony floor with his hands resting quietly in his lap, the sparrow settled on the rim of the tulsi pot above her nest, warm lamplight from the doorway and a deep evening sky beyond the railing.

title: 💪 Anaya knots her snapped kite string on the stairs and it slips apart… #shorts #kidsstories
title_alts: 💪 How can Anaya tie the knot with one hand busy on the kite string? #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
💪 Anaya, one kite and a string that snapped halfway up the stairwell… #shorts #kidsstories
refrain: Two pairs of hands, one kite.
description_hook: Anaya's kite string snaps halfway up the apartment stairwell, and one pair of hands cannot hold and tie at the same time. Then she spots Kabir two steps below her.

characters.name: Anaya
characters.description: six years old, short black hair held back with two red clips, yellow kurta over green shorts, a red paper kite tucked under one arm

characters.name: Kabir
characters.description: seven years old, curly black hair, blue t-shirt with a torn sleeve, carries a wooden kite reel wherever he goes

scenes.narration: Anaya climbed the stairwell with her kite. She wanted it over the terrace. Two pairs of hands, one kite.
scenes.caption: अनाया पतंग लेकर सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ी। वह उसे छत के ऊपर उड़ाना चाहती थी। दो जोड़ी हाथ, एक पतंग।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya, a six-year-old girl in a yellow kurta, climbs the concrete steps of an apartment stairwell holding a red paper kite. Afternoon sunlight comes through the barred stairwell window.

scenes.narration: She tugged. The kite lifted off the railing. Then the string snapped.
scenes.caption: उसने खींचा। पतंग रेलिंग से ऊपर उठी। तभी डोर टूट गई।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya stands on the stairwell landing beside the iron railing, the red kite tilting above her head and the broken white string curling loose from her hand. Bright daylight from the open window.

scenes.narration: Anaya knotted the loose ends. Tug with me, gently now. The knot slipped apart.
scenes.caption: अनाया ने ढीले सिरे बाँधे। मेरे साथ धीरे से खींचो। गाँठ खुल गई।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya sits on a stairwell step holding the two loose ends of the white kite string together in her fingers, the red kite lying flat beside her feet. Warm light on the grey steps.

scenes.narration: Anaya's fingers ached. One hand held the string. The other could not tie.
scenes.caption: अनाया की उँगलियाँ दुखने लगीं। एक हाथ डोर थामे था। दूसरा बाँध नहीं पाया।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya on a stairwell step with one hand gripping the tight white string and the other fumbling at the loose end, her forehead creased with effort. Window light falls across her hands.

scenes.narration: Anaya saw Kabir two steps below. He could hold. She could tie. Two pairs of hands, one kite.
scenes.caption: अनाया ने कबीर को दो सीढ़ी नीचे देखा। वह थामेगा। वह बाँधेगी। दो जोड़ी हाथ, एक पतंग।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya looks down from her step at Kabir, a seven-year-old boy in a blue t-shirt holding a wooden kite reel, standing two steps below her in the apartment stairwell. Daylight from the window between them.

scenes.narration: Kabir pinched the ends still. Anaya wound the knot tight. Count with me. One, two, three. The kite climbed.
scenes.caption: कबीर ने सिरे थामे। अनाया ने गाँठ कसी। मेरे साथ गिनो। एक, दो, तीन। पतंग चढ़ गई।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir pinches the two ends of the white string steady while Anaya winds the knot tight, both kneeling on the stairwell landing, the red kite lifting past the open window into bright sky.

scenes.narration: Anaya grinned and gave Kabir the reel first. Two pairs of hands, one kite.
scenes.caption: अनाया मुस्कुराई और चरखी पहले कबीर को दी। दो जोड़ी हाथ, एक पतंग।
scenes.image_brief: Anaya grins on the stairwell landing with her hand on the string while Kabir holds the wooden reel, and the red kite flies small and high beyond the open window in late afternoon light.

title: ✨ Sia stays up late on the dark terrace and nothing enormous happens… #shorts #bedtimestories
title_alts: ✨ What is Sia waiting for on a cold terrace where nothing happens? #shorts #bedtimestories
✨ Sia, one late night and a terrace wind that finds her bare ankles… #shorts #bedtimestories
refrain: The night is awake with me
description_hook: Sia gets the late night she begged for, and the terrace turns out colder and quieter than she pictured. Then she works out what all that quiet is actually for.

characters.name: Sia
characters.description: seven years old, one short braid tied with red thread, yellow kurta and pyjamas, always barefoot

scenes.narration: Sia stood barefoot on the dark terrace. She wanted to stay up late. Just tonight.
scenes.caption: सिया नंगे पैर अँधेरी छत पर खड़ी थी। उसे आज रात देर तक जागना था। बस आज।
scenes.image_brief: Sia, a seven-year-old girl with one short braid and a yellow kurta, standing barefoot on an open rooftop terrace at night, low parapet wall and neighbouring rooftops behind her, one dim bulb glowing over the stairway door

scenes.narration: Her mother said yes tonight. Sia sat on the cool cement, waiting. The night is awake with me.
scenes.caption: आज माँ ने हाँ कह दी। सिया ठंडी छत पर बैठकर इंतज़ार करने लगी। रात मेरे साथ जागी है।
scenes.image_brief: Sia sitting cross-legged on the bare cement floor of the terrace, looking up at a dark sky with a few faint stars, a woman holding the stairway curtain open behind her, warm yellow light spilling from the doorway

scenes.narration: Nothing enormous happened. Sia hummed, then stamped, still waiting for magic.
scenes.caption: कुछ भी बड़ा नहीं हुआ। सिया गुनगुनाई, पैर पटके, जादू का इंतज़ार करती रही।
scenes.image_brief: Sia on the empty terrace with her mouth open humming and one bare foot mid-stamp, plain dark sky above with no moon, silent rooftops around her, faint light from the stairway door

scenes.narration: The wind found her ankles. Her nose turned to ice. Say it with me: brrr!
scenes.caption: हवा उसके टखनों तक पहुँच गई। नाक बर्फ़ जैसी हो गई। मेरे साथ बोलो — ब्र्र्र!
scenes.image_brief: Sia hunched small on the terrace floor with her arms crossed tight over her chest, braid and kurta hem blown sideways by wind, bare ankles pulled under her, deep blue sky with one pale star

scenes.narration: Then Sia stopped stamping and listened. A cricket. A dog. Her own breath. The night is awake with me.
scenes.caption: फिर सिया रुकी और सुनने लगी। एक झींगुर। एक कुत्ता। अपनी ही साँस। रात मेरे साथ जागी है।
scenes.image_brief: Sia sitting very still on the terrace with her head turned to one side to listen, a cricket perched on the parapet wall near her, a dog standing in the dark lane below, many more stars now showing in the sky

scenes.narration: Sia hugged her knees and grinned. Count three stars with me! Quiet was hers now.
scenes.caption: सिया ने घुटने समेटे और मुस्कुराई। मेरे साथ तीन तारे गिनो! अब यह चुप्पी उसकी थी।
scenes.image_brief: Sia hugging her knees to her chest on the terrace floor, grinning up at the sky, three bright stars above the rooftop water tank, dim glow from the stairway door behind her

scenes.narration: Sia tipped her head all the way back. The night is awake with me.
scenes.caption: सिया ने सिर पीछे तक झुका दिया। रात मेरे साथ जागी है।
scenes.image_brief: Sia lying back on the terrace floor with her head tipped far up, the whole sky crowded with stars above her, dark rooftops all around, a thin band of light from the open doorway

title: 😟 Reyansh reaches in to pay and finds only a hole in his pocket… #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
title_alts: 😟 Where did Reyansh drop Grandmother's coin in a loud vegetable market? #shorts #kidsstories
😟 Reyansh, one coin from Grandmother and six tomatoes he cannot pay for… #shorts #kidsstories
description_hook: Reyansh has one coin from his grandmother and six tomatoes to buy. When the coin slips away in the vegetable market, he walks the whole row backwards to find it himself.

characters.name: Reyansh
characters.description: 6-year-old boy, short black hair, green kurta with blue shorts, a small torn hole in his right pocket

scenes.narration: Reyansh held Grandmother's coin tight in the vegetable market. He wanted six red tomatoes.
scenes.caption: रेयांश दादी का सिक्का थामे सब्ज़ी बाज़ार में खड़ा था। उसे छह लाल टमाटर चाहिए थे।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh, a six-year-old boy in a green kurta and blue shorts, stands in a crowded vegetable market holding a small silver coin tight in his fist, baskets of red tomatoes and onions on either side of him, bright morning sunlight across the stalls.

scenes.narration: Reyansh reached in to pay. His pocket held only a hole. Back the way I came.
scenes.caption: पैसे देने जेब में हाथ डाला, वहाँ बस एक छेद था। जिस रास्ते से आया, उसी से लौटूँ।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh at a tomato stall with one hand pushed deep into his empty shorts pocket, a small torn hole showing in the cloth, a vendor waiting behind piles of red tomatoes, sunlight coming through the stall's cloth roof.

scenes.narration: He shook the pocket. He peeked under the tomato crates. Only dust and one pea.
scenes.caption: उसने जेब झाड़ी। टमाटर की टोकरियों के नीचे झाँका। बस धूल और एक मटर मिला।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh crouched low in the market aisle, shaking his pocket inside out while peering under stacked wooden tomato crates, dust and a single green pea on the ground beside his sandal, shade under the crates with bright light beyond.

scenes.narration: The market grew loud. His chest went tight and his eyes stung.
scenes.caption: बाज़ार का शोर बढ़ गया। सीना कस गया और आँखें जलने लगीं।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh standing small in the middle of a busy market lane crowded with shoppers' legs and heavy baskets, his shoulders hunched and his eyes wet, harsh midday light falling between the stall covers.

scenes.narration: Then Reyansh remembered sniffing the coriander bundle. Say it with me. Back the way I came.
scenes.caption: तभी रेयांश को धनिया सूँघना याद आया। मेरे साथ बोलो। जिस रास्ते से आया, उसी से लौटूँ।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh standing still in the market lane with one finger raised as he remembers, turning his head to look back down the row toward a stall heaped with green coriander bundles, warm sunlight along the stalls.

scenes.narration: Past the onions, past the beans. There shone the coin. Reyansh grinned and bought six tomatoes.
scenes.caption: प्याज़ पार, बीन्स पार। वहीं सिक्का चमका। रेयांश ने हँसकर छह टमाटर खरीद लिए।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh standing beside bundles of green coriander, grinning as he holds up the found silver coin, while a vendor drops six red tomatoes into his cloth bag, a pile of onions and a basket of beans in front of them, bright sunlight on the coin.

scenes.narration: Reyansh felt braver than before. Say it once more with me. Back the way I came.
scenes.caption: रेयांश को खुद पर भरोसा हुआ। एक बार फिर बोलो। जिस रास्ते से आया, उसी से लौटूँ।
scenes.image_brief: Reyansh at the market gate hugging a cloth bag of red tomatoes against his chest, chin lifted and smiling, rows of vegetable stalls behind him, warm morning light on the path home.

title: 💛 Myra edges closer to the courtyard rope and nobody hears her hello… #shorts #kidsstories
title_alts: 💛 Why can't Myra ask for one turn at the courtyard skipping rope? #shorts #kidsstories #storytime
💛 Myra, a tangled ankle and a rope that stops the moment she jumps in… #shorts #kidsstories
refrain: Turn the rope, and jump right in
description_hook: Myra wants one turn at the courtyard skipping rope, but her voice keeps going quiet. She finds her own way into the game, starting with the rope end nobody is holding.

characters.name: Myra
characters.description: seven years old, short black hair in two small plaits, faded yellow kurta over blue shorts, a red plastic bangle on her right wrist

scenes.narration: Myra stood by the courtyard wall, watching the rope. She wanted one turn.
scenes.caption: मायरा आँगन की दीवार से रस्सी देखती रही। उसे एक बारी चाहिए थी।
scenes.image_brief: Myra, a seven-year-old girl with two short plaits in a faded yellow kurta and blue shorts, stands pressed against the painted wall of an apartment building courtyard in warm late afternoon light, watching four older children swing a long skipping rope a few steps away.

scenes.narration: She edged closer and said hello. Nobody heard. Turn the rope, and jump right in.
scenes.caption: वह थोड़ा पास गई और हलो बोली। किसी ने नहीं सुना। रस्सी घुमाओ, और कूद पड़ो।
scenes.image_brief: Myra has taken one small step away from the courtyard wall with her mouth barely open as she speaks, while the older children keep swinging the long rope and look at each other instead of at her, low golden sunlight across the tiles.

scenes.narration: Myra hopped in anyway. The rope tangled round her ankle. The jumping stopped.
scenes.caption: मायरा फिर भी कूद गई। रस्सी उसके टखने में उलझ गई। कूदना रुक गया।
scenes.image_brief: Myra stands off balance in the middle of the courtyard with the long skipping rope wrapped once around her right ankle, the two rope turners holding slack rope and standing still, the other children stopped and looking at her, bright afternoon light on the tiles.

scenes.narration: Her ears burned. Turn the rope, and jump right in. Myra only whispered it.
scenes.caption: उसके कान गरम हो गए। रस्सी घुमाओ, और कूद पड़ो। मायरा ने बस फुसफुसाकर कहा।
scenes.image_brief: Myra is back at the edge of the courtyard with her ears and cheeks flushed red and her lips barely moving, both hands gripping the hem of her kurta, the skipping rope lying still on the sunlit tiles behind her.

scenes.narration: Then Myra noticed something. Two tiny kids could not jump the fast rope.
scenes.caption: तभी मायरा ने कुछ देखा। दो नन्हे बच्चे तेज़ रस्सी पर कूद नहीं पा रहे थे।
scenes.image_brief: Myra looks across the courtyard at two much smaller children, about four years old, who hang back near a flower pot with their hands behind them while the long rope whips past fast in front of them, warm late afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Myra took one end herself and turned it low. Turn with me, gently.
scenes.caption: मायरा ने खुद एक सिरा लिया और नीचे-नीचे घुमाया। मेरे साथ घुमाओ, धीरे से।
scenes.image_brief: Myra crouches at one side of the courtyard holding one end of the long skipping rope and swinging it in a low flat arc close to the tiles, an older girl holding the far end, the two smallest children stepping up to it, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: The tiny ones jumped. Count with me. One, two, three! The big girls waved Myra in.
scenes.caption: नन्हे बच्चे कूदे। मेरे साथ गिनो। एक, दो, तीन! बड़ी लड़कियों ने मायरा को बुला लिया।
scenes.image_brief: The two smallest children hop over the low turning rope in the courtyard while Myra keeps turning her end, and one of the older girls beckons her toward the waiting line of jumpers, late afternoon sunlight on the building walls.

scenes.narration: Myra's cheeks were warm, the happy kind. Turn the rope, and jump right in.
scenes.caption: अब मायरा के गाल खुशी से गरम थे। रस्सी घुमाओ, और कूद पड़ो।
scenes.image_brief: Myra stands inside the swinging skipping rope in the middle of the courtyard mid-jump with both feet off the tiles, cheeks pink and grinning, the two smallest children clapping at the side, warm evening light on the apartment walls.

title: 🧡 Ira kneels at the monsoon window and ten raindrops keep racing away… #shorts #kidspoems #rhymes
title_alts: 🧡 How can Ira count ten raindrops when every drop slides away? #shorts #kidspoems #rhymes
🧡 Ira, her grandfather and ten raindrops that will not hold their place… #shorts #kidspoems #rhymes
refrain: Ten little raindrops on the glass.
description_hook: Rain runs down the window and Ira starts counting, but the drops keep racing away. So she breathes on the cold glass, draws a line down the middle, and gives her grandfather one half to count.

characters.name: Ira
characters.description: five years old, short black hair in two short braids with red ribbons, yellow kurta over blue pyjamas, a round smudge of window fog always on her nose

scenes.narration: Ira kneels at the monsoon window. Her grandfather sits beside her.
scenes.caption: इरा बरसाती खिड़की पर बैठी है। दादाजी उसके पास बैठे हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Ira, a five-year-old girl with two short braids and a yellow kurta, kneels on a cushion at a tall window streaked with monsoon rain, her grandfather in a grey shawl sitting beside her on the floor, grey daylight coming through the wet glass

scenes.narration: One drop hits the glass. Two more slide and pass. Ira counts the race. Can drops hold their place?
scenes.caption: एक बूँद शीशे से टकराई। दो और फिसल गईं। इरा दौड़ गिनती है। बूँदें रुकेंगी क्या?
scenes.image_brief: Ira points a finger at three fat raindrops racing down the window glass, her grandfather in his grey shawl leaning in to look, a dripping balcony railing and wet street behind the glass, dull grey afternoon light

scenes.narration: Ten little raindrops on the glass.
scenes.caption: शीशे पर दस नन्हीं बूँदें।
scenes.image_brief: Ten round raindrops clinging to the window pane in front of Ira, her fingertip resting on one of them, her grandfather's wrinkled hand on the wooden sill, soft rainy light

scenes.narration: Ira breathes a foggy line. Half is his, half is mine. Numbers tumble left and right. Count out loud with might!
scenes.caption: इरा फूँक से धुँधली लकीर खींचती है। आधा उनका, आधा मेरा। ज़ोर से गिनो!
scenes.image_brief: Ira breathes on the cold window and drags her finger down the middle of the fogged glass, splitting it into two halves, her grandfather in the grey shawl watching the half nearest him, dim rain light from outside

scenes.narration: Ten little raindrops on the glass.
scenes.caption: शीशे पर दस नन्हीं बूँदें।
scenes.image_brief: The fogged window pane divided by Ira's finger line, five raindrops clinging on each half, Ira and her grandfather in the grey shawl holding up counting fingers, grey light on their faces

scenes.narration: The rain is soft and slow. Just ten drops to go. Whisper ten with Ira, please. Grandfather smiles at the breeze.
scenes.caption: बारिश नरम और धीमी है। बस दस बूँदें बाकी। इरा के साथ दस फुसफुसाओ। दादाजी मुस्कुराते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The rain has thinned to a few slow drops on the window, Ira resting her chin on the sill and whispering, her grandfather in the grey shawl smiling as a breeze lifts the curtain beside them, pale light after the shower

scenes.narration: Ira hugs her grandfather, warm and proud. Ten little raindrops on the glass.
scenes.caption: इरा दादाजी से लिपट जाती है, गर्म और गर्वीली। शीशे पर दस नन्हीं बूँदें।
scenes.image_brief: Ira hugging her grandfather in his grey shawl in front of the rain-streaked window, both of them smiling, raindrops still sitting on the glass behind them, warm lamp light inside and soft grey light outside

description_hook: Every toy on Zoya's shelf has gone quiet before she has. A slowing bedtime rhyme with one whisper and one big yawn to join in.

characters.name: Zoya
characters.description: four years old, short black hair with one small braid, blue star-print pyjamas, always holds a flat yellow pillow

scenes.narration: Zoya climbs into bed and peeks at her toy shelf.
scenes.caption: ज़ोया बिस्तर पर चढ़ती है और अपने खिलौनों की शेल्फ़ देखती है।
scenes.image_brief: Zoya, a four year old girl in blue star-print pyjamas with one small braid, sitting up in her small bed and looking across at a wooden shelf of toys. A bedside lamp gives warm light, the window behind is dark.

scenes.narration: The teddy bear has shut his eyes. The rag doll softly sighs. The blocks stand stacked tight. Nobody moves tonight.
scenes.caption: भालू ने आँखें बंद कीं। गुड़िया आह भरती है। ब्लॉक जमे हैं। कोई नहीं हिलता।
scenes.image_brief: The wooden shelf in Zoya's bedroom holding a teddy bear with closed eyes and folded paws, a rag doll lying on its side, a neat stack of wooden blocks and a small tin drum. Zoya watches from her bed behind them in soft lamp light.

scenes.narration: Sleepy toys, sleepy Zoya, goodnight.
scenes.caption: नींद भरे खिलौने, नींद भरी ज़ोया, शुभ रात्रि।
scenes.image_brief: Zoya leaning back onto her pillow with the blanket up to her chin and her eyes half closed, the shelf of still toys beside the bed. Dim lamp light spreads across the blanket.

scenes.narration: Zoya counts them, one to four. No one asks for more. Whisper goodnight along with me. The shelf is quiet as can be.
scenes.caption: ज़ोया चार तक गिनती है। कोई और कुछ नहीं मांगता। साथ में शुभ रात्रि कहो। शेल्फ़ शांत है।
scenes.image_brief: Zoya sitting up in bed with one finger out, pointing at the teddy bear, the rag doll, the stack of blocks and the tin drum in turn, her mouth open in a whisper. Lamp light falls on her hand and on the shelf.

scenes.narration: Sleepy toys, sleepy Zoya, goodnight.
scenes.caption: नींद भरे खिलौने, नींद भरी ज़ोया, शुभ रात्रि।
scenes.image_brief: Zoya settled under her blanket with one arm around her flat yellow pillow, the teddy bear, rag doll, blocks and tin drum still in place on the shelf. The lamp light is lower now and the room is dimmer.

scenes.narration: Zoya breathes out, long and deep. She copies every toy asleep. Her eyelids fall without a sound. Night wraps softly round.
scenes.caption: ज़ोया लंबी सांस छोड़ती है। वह सोए खिलौनों की नकल करती है। पलकें चुपचाप गिर जाती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Zoya lying flat on her back with her chest lowering as she breathes out, eyes closed, blanket smooth over her, the shelf of quiet toys nearby. Only a faint nightlight glow remains in the dark bedroom.

scenes.narration: Yawn one big yawn with me. Sleepy toys, sleepy Zoya, goodnight.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ एक बड़ी जम्हाई लो। नींद भरे खिलौने, नींद भरी ज़ोया, शुभ रात्रि।
scenes.image_brief: Zoya yawning wide with her eyes shut, blanket pulled up to her shoulders, her flat yellow pillow under her cheek, and the teddy bear, rag doll, blocks and tin drum on the shelf above her. Faint nightlight glow in the dark room.

description_hook: One number, five things to count, and one open hand to hold up. Advik counts orange segments, buttons, spoons and claps at the kitchen table.

characters.name: Advik
characters.description: five years old, short black hair, green t-shirt with a small pocket, a gap between his front teeth

scenes.narration: Advik is learning the number five today. Hold up five, that's a whole hand.
scenes.caption: अद्विक आज पाँच की संख्या सीख रहा है। पाँच उठाओ, यह पूरा हाथ है।
scenes.image_brief: Advik, a five-year-old boy with short black hair and a green t-shirt, sitting at a wooden kitchen table with a large cut-out numeral 5 propped up in front of him, morning light from a window

scenes.narration: Five has a flat hat and a round belly. Five, five.
scenes.caption: पाँच के ऊपर चपटी टोपी और नीचे गोल पेट होता है। पाँच, पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: A large cut-out numeral 5 standing on a wooden kitchen table, Advik's finger following the flat bar across its top and the round curve at its bottom, bright even light

scenes.narration: Five orange segments sit on Advik's kitchen table. Count: one, two, three, four, five.
scenes.caption: अद्विक की मेज़ पर संतरे की पाँच फाँकें। गिनो: एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: Five orange segments in a row on a white plate on a wooden kitchen table beside the cut-out numeral 5, Advik looking down at the plate, morning light

scenes.narration: Your turn. Count to five with Advik. Ready? Lift one finger for each segment.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। अद्विक के साथ पाँच तक गिनो, हर फाँक पर एक उँगली उठाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Advik at the wooden kitchen table lifting his fingers one by one above the plate of five orange segments, his hand held up in front of him, bright daylight

scenes.narration: Five! Hold up five, that's a whole hand.
scenes.caption: पाँच! पाँच उठाओ, यह पूरा हाथ है।
scenes.image_brief: Advik's open hand raised beside the cut-out numeral 5 on the wooden kitchen table, all five fingers spread wide, cheerful daylight

scenes.narration: Five buttons down Advik's shirt. Five spoons in the jar. Same five!
scenes.caption: अद्विक की कमीज़ पर पाँच बटन। जार में पाँच चम्मच। वही पाँच!
scenes.image_brief: Five round buttons down the front of Advik's green t-shirt, and five spoons standing in a clay jar on the wooden kitchen table beside him, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Advik claps five slow claps. Clap and count: one, two, three, four, five.
scenes.caption: अद्विक पाँच बार धीरे ताली बजाता है। गिनो: एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: Advik at the wooden kitchen table with his palms together mid-clap, the cut-out numeral 5 standing behind him and the jar of five spoons beside it, warm daylight

scenes.narration: Which is five: four spoons, or five spoons? Five spoons! One more than four.
scenes.caption: पाँच कौन है — चार चम्मच या पाँच चम्मच? पाँच चम्मच! चार से एक ज़्यादा।
scenes.image_brief: Four spoons laid out on the left side of a wooden kitchen table and five spoons laid out on the right, the cut-out numeral 5 standing between the two groups, even light

scenes.narration: Segments, buttons, spoons, claps — each one was five. Hold up five, that's a whole hand.
scenes.caption: फाँकें, बटन, चम्मच, तालियाँ — हर बार पाँच। पाँच उठाओ, यह पूरा हाथ है।
scenes.image_brief: Five orange segments, five buttons, five spoons and Advik's open raised hand arranged around the cut-out numeral 5 on a wooden kitchen table, soft evening light

scenes.image_brief: Nia clapping once above the red wooden triangle on the blue play mat, the three corners of the triangle pointing outward, cheerful morning light

scenes.narration: A paper party hat on the mat. Its top is a corner. Triangle!
scenes.caption: चटाई पर कागज़ की टोपी — इसका ऊपरी सिरा एक कोना है। त्रिभुज!
scenes.image_brief: A striped paper party hat standing upright on the blue play mat with Nia's finger pointing at its top corner, the red wooden triangle behind it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Nia's toy boat has a white sail. Three sides, three corners, triangle!
scenes.caption: निया की खिलौना नाव का सफ़ेद पाल — तीन भुजाएँ, तीन कोने, त्रिभुज!
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden toy boat on the blue play mat with a white cloth sail shaped like a triangle, Nia holding the boat steady with both hands, bright light

scenes.narration: Which is the triangle? A round ball, or a party hat? The hat!
scenes.caption: त्रिभुज कौन है — गोल गेंद या कागज़ की टोपी? टोपी!
scenes.image_brief: A round orange ball on the left side of the blue play mat and a striped paper party hat on the right, the red wooden triangle resting between them, even daylight

scenes.narration: Sandwich, party hat, boat sail. All triangles. Three sides, three corners, triangle!
scenes.caption: सैंडविच, टोपी, नाव का पाल — सब त्रिभुज। तीन भुजाएँ, तीन कोने, त्रिभुज!
scenes.image_brief: The half sandwich, the striped paper party hat and the toy boat with its white sail lined up in a row on the blue play mat, the red wooden triangle standing behind them, warm evening light
